newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK INSURERS HIT BY 2.3BLN IN STORM DAMAGE CLAIMS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK INSURERS HIT BY 2.3BLN IN STORM DAMAGE CLAIMS.

text.p: Insurance Companies said claims for storm-related damages in
December and January reached 2.35 billion drachmas.
Claims totalled 311, with 150 related to damages in
homes, where the average claim was for 542,790 drachmas, it
Noting that the greater Athens metropolitan area remained
vulnerable to catastrophic floods, it provided the following
statistics for storm-related damages in the last three years:
-- 1,020 homes with total claims of 1.18 billion drachmas
-- 633 commercial businesses with claims of 3.9 billion
-- 285 industrial firms had claims of 7.8 billion
-- 116 miscellaneous cases with total claims of 906 million
